malformed_utf8_read_boundary.component: vte 0.15.0 parser, used by both the core and observer
malformed_utf8_read_boundary.reason: A split after UTF-8 byte CE, followed by 9B 48 84, loses the printable H that a whole-stream feed retains. Both the core and observer use vte 0.15.0. CAN does not restore the lost character. A subsequent explicit cancel, reset and clear resynchronizes both views for new output. This is a tracked malformed-input decoding deviation; valid UTF-8 streams retain the stronger chunk-invariance oracle.
